rationale: Previous prompt-end token boosts corrupted continuation and ignored multi-token names. Change factual relation completion states, including every subtoken of each short concept, using their measured output contrasts and all down-projection columns. Average keys across two questions and five grammatical contexts. Preserve dominant control activation subspace. No complete answer or termination token is programmed.
formula: K=mean relation activations per concept/subtoken; Q=top protected right-singular vectors; Z=K-KQQt; D=pinv(Z); deltaW=Vt Dt. V=mean bounded RMS-scaled contrast against native top competitor.
first_subtoken_keys: Separate key for each grammatical relation prefix, averaged only across the two development questions. Later subtoken keys stay averaged.
reason_for_revision: Variant 2 gave real but limited corrections and partial paraphrase transfer in Ollama. Extend the same explicit algebra to nose, deceivers, donkey, ending and five major episodic roles from the original atlas. The final benchmark remains unused.
